correctness.rationale: Local prime-power multiplicative identities imply log rho_q(v)<=1_{q|n}/q. Exact CRT cylinder densities and squarefree-tail Euler products prove the lower bound. For negative cylinders, log R<0 forces tail reciprocal-prime mass >1-R, and uniform integrable tails make the conditional first moment equal w_a mu/D; Markov then supplies an upper-density bound. The packaged standard-library script enumerates exactly 5896800 cases and verifies the rational thresholds, prime-square-tail sieve and pi bound. The argument does not rely on an unproved density limit.
